0bb57e6c3f.q: What are the four choices Kanae Corder recommends when a challenge or obstacle comes into your way?
0bb57e6c3f.a: When a challenge or an obstacle comes into your way you have four choices: you go over, you go under, you go around, or you sit your ass down. Corder emphasizes that if you have been taking what she calls a presidential pause over and over again, it has to stop, because if you keep pausing, you are never going to get where you are going.

74c232cc14.q: What does Kanae Corder mean by financial hypnotherapy and how does it differ from traditional therapy?

55670f35d9.q: According to Kanae Corder, why do people remain stuck in repetitive patterns even when those patterns are not working?
55670f35d9.a: The reason why you are not breaking the loop is because it is familiar and familiar feels good, even when it feels bad. It feels better than the unknown. Corder explains that if familiar keeps you looping and looping is not working, then you have to try one of the other options—go over, under, or around the obstacle.

02bebdd88a.q: What does Kanae Corder advise about managing revenue, debt, and expenses during an economic downturn?
02bebdd88a.a: Corder recommends getting your revenue up right now and doing it quickly. Once you raise revenue, you should pay off some debt, save some money, and put some in savings—not putting all towards debt so you stay in balance. Additionally, you should lower your expenses wherever you can but not so much that you feel deprived, and focus on maximizing your needs rather than raising any expenses.
